crossRefs.note: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from…
All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is educated, saying…
and the book is delivered to one who is not educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t read.”
O Yahweh, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but…
“But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their…
The streets of the city will be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.”

parallels.note: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their…
and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’

translations.web: They are like children who sit in the marketplace, and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’
translations.bsb: They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling out to one another: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not weep.’
translations.kjv: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.
translations.asv: They are like unto children that sit in the marketplace, and call one to another; who say, We piped unto you, and ye did not dance; we wailed, and ye did not weep.
